endorsements.quote: The generation of non-existent Vancouver-style citations (phantom citations) demands the integration of evidence-based tools (like Consensus or Elicit) and the strict verification of primary databases 3 , 8 .

unlisted_practices: Use structured prompt engineering (context, request, persona, output format) and instruct AI to think step by step to reduce logical errors in clinical tasks.
Explicitly include diversity, equity, and inclusion parameters in prompts to avoid perpetuating biases in AI-generated educational content.
Maintain human clinical judgment as the final filter over AI outputs and do not trust AI blindly.

screen.reason: An editorial discussing prompt engineering techniques and recommendations for using generative AI safely and effectively in medical education and clinical tasks.
